name: grid
description: Fits as many equal columns as the container allows at a minimum width, up to an optional maximum count.

attributes.name: data-min
attributes.description: The narrowest a column may be. With none, only data-columns decides the count; none is meant to be paired with data-columns, and alone gives a single full-width column.

attributes.name: data-columns
attributes.description: The most columns allowed. Fewer appear when the container cannot fit that many at data-min; with data-min="none" the count is exact. With data-fold, the count only ever halves.

attributes.name: data-rows
attributes.description: Line up the parts of the children across each row: the value is how many rows each child spans, one per part.

attributes.name: data-fold
attributes.description: Halve the column count as the grid narrows instead of stepping down one at a time. Needs data-columns 2, 4, or 6 and uses data-min as the width per column. data-min="none" has no meaning with a fold: the count needs a width per column.

attributes.name: data-tracks
attributes.description: A fixed number of equal tracks that children are placed on with data-start and data-span, leaving any track nothing is placed on empty. Replaces the fitted columns, so data-min and data-columns have no effect alongside it, and it does not mix with data-fold.

attributes.name: data-threshold
attributes.description: With data-tracks: the grid's own width below which every child takes the whole row, in source order; at or above it, the placement applies.

children.description: The cells. All are the same width, except in a tracks grid, where each covers the tracks it is placed on.

markers.name: data-start
markers.description: In a tracks grid, the column line the child begins on. Without it the child flows into the next free track.

markers.name: data-span
markers.description: In a tracks grid, how many tracks the child covers. Without it the child covers one.

a11y.notes: Purely visual. Use a list when the cells are a list of like things.
